show.description: Riyansh Singhaniya, a billionaire CEO travels to a small town to buy land for his first mall—only to discover that an old, struggling couple refusing to sell may actually be his long-lost parents. Going undercover as a common man, he witnesses their poverty, humiliation, and the cruelty of their greedy relatives.
